answer: Start with Drying yard master brine barrel seal countersigned by the drying yard. The credential behind it reads each brine barrel is a measured salt yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must, and that is the point. No bulk discount exists: 629 aliases need 629 proofs, and each proof is 92 POA the farm cannot reuse. One ivory per identity, one walnut per alias, one tide per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
